verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API-first card-issuing platform with a public API reference at developers.pomelo.la. The evidence references specific endpoint areas: digital accounts, transaction authorization and adjustments, and an Adjustments endpoint for reversals and refunds. Its official MCP server can search endpoints and generate request code, which supports programmatic, agent-driven use. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), authentication and access details for the public API, endpoint-level documentation depth in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.
